material_systems.name: Standard Acrylic Trim Enamel

products: Benjamin Moore Fresh Start Acrylic Primer
primer.notes: Factory-primed doors may skip primer with scuff sand. Bare wood always requires primer.

products: Sherwin-Williams ProClassic Waterborne Interior Acrylic Enamel
Benjamin Moore Regal Select Interior Semi-Gloss
finish.notes: Fast dry/recoat. Non-yellowing. Water cleanup. Lower hardness than alkyd — blocking risk on doors.

material_systems.notes: Standard production system. Satin is typical sheen for QT3 doors.

material_systems.name: Modified Urethane Trim Enamel

products: Benjamin Moore Fresh Start High-Hiding Primer
primer.notes: Bonding primer recommended for QT4 for best adhesion. Factory-primed may skip with assessment.

products: Sherwin-Williams Pro Industrial Waterbased Alkyd Urethane
Benjamin Moore Advance Waterborne Interior Alkyd
finish.notes: Superior flow and leveling. Harder cured film. Extended cure time (7+ days full hardness). Blocking resistant.

material_systems.notes: Premium residential standard. Semi-gloss is typical for QT4 doors.

material_systems.name: Premium Urethane Trim Enamel

products: Benjamin Moore Fresh Start High-Hiding Primer
primer.notes: QT5 typically includes primer regardless of factory prime status for uniform base.

finish.notes: Maximum durability. Excellent leveling. Hardest film. Highest cost.

material_systems.notes: Premium/custom home standard. Any sheen including gloss.

specialty_primers.name: Shellac-based knot sealer
specialty_primers.when_to_use: Bare solid wood doors with visible knots (pine, knotty alder)
specialty_primers.notes: Spot-apply over knots and tannin-bleed areas before full primer. Not a full-coat product.

specialty_primers.name: MDF edge sealer
specialty_primers.notes: MDF edges are porous — water causes swelling. Seal all edges before water-based primer.
